reason: From 2015/16 Geostat counts certified physician (veterinarian) programmes and residency at master's level, following ISCED 2011. Sheet Number, A103: "Note: From 2015-2016 school year in accordance with the International Standard Classification of Education (ISCED 2011), certified doctor (veterinarian) program, residency - are included in the Masters level." The level headings change from "Bachelor or Certified physician programme" and "Magistracy or Residency" to "Bachelor programme" and "Magistracy, Certified physician (Veterinarian) or Residency". No change may be computed across this point.
